Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the secretary of transportation to realign the transportation regions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the realignment of transportation regions; andadding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature recognizes that the urban corridors officewithin the department operates as a seventh administrative region.Therefore, the legislature intends that the regional consolidation inthis section will result in a decrease in the number of total regions.This consolidation will also result in a reduction in the amount ofregional management level staff by at least five percent by July 1,2011. (2) Beginning in January 2010 and completed by July 1, 2011, as ameans of reducing department administrative costs and providing moreefficient use of department resources, the secretary shall realign thetransportation regions to generally include: (a) The Olympic region, containing Clallam, Jefferson, GraysHarbor, Mason, Lewis, Kitsap, and Thurston counties; p. 1 ESSB 5682 (b) The southwest region, containing Pacific, Wahkiakum, Cowlitz,Clark, and Skamania counties; (c) The northwest region, containing San Juan, Island, Whatcom, andSkagit counties; (d) The Puget Sound region, containing King, Pierce, and Snohomishcounties; (e) The south central region, containing Chelan, Douglas, Grant,Kittitas, Yakima, Benton, Franklin, and Klickitat counties, with aconnection into Walla Walla county along state route number 12 to theTriCities area; and (f) The eastern region, containing Okanogan, Ferry, Stevens, PendOreille, Lincoln, Spokane, Adams, Whitman, Columbia, Garfield, andAsotin counties, and that portion of Walla Walla county not included in(e) of this subsection.
